summary: NeoVolta Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an underwritten public offering of 12,195,122 shares of common stock at $2.05 per share, raising net proceeds of approximately $23.5 million, with a 30-day overallotment option for up to 1,829,268 additional shares. The offering was conducted under an effective shelf registration statement (Form S-3) and is a capital-raise event, not a transformative special situation. Proceeds are intended for joint venture obligations, working capital, and general corporate purposes. The underwriter is Lake Street Capital Markets, LLC, receiving a 6.0% discount. A 60-day lock-up restricts further equity sales. Watch for potential dilution impact and use of proceeds on operations.
